body: It kind of seems like a local problem on your end. when I go to your stackblitz the links work just fine.

Although I doubt it - I have tested Safari TP and Arc (Chromium 111) on my end and my friend managed to get it in Brave and Edge when I hadn't deployed a workaround.

Maybe try deploying the example code to Vercel and see if it still doesn't reproduce?
Will do, although if it doesnt work on stackblitz for you either I dont really expect deploying a fork onto vercel will net any results tho.

I honestly have no idea what it can be at this point considering you don't have it @JesseKoldewijn, but if there are any debugging steps I can help with just say the word!

Just managed to reproduce it on my PC with Windows 10 and Chrome. So I doubt this is an OS or browser issue, but it's certainly weird behavior.

yeah, for me it now seems like that the dynamic route of /blog/a-post doesn't work but all the other routes work just fine. Kinda wonky cuz it worked for me before and in the stackblitz as well. How random.

lol, just found out what the issue probably is. Having a dynamic route without having a page in the root of the folder breaks the route behavior apparently. 

Fixed it by adding a page to the /blog directory.
Right, that was what the bug report was for. But it should work even as written without having to change anything in the example code.
fair fair, it is still kinda odd that it is able to find the page contents without linking to it tho.
I'll have a look into it, maybe I can find where it breaks 😄

Welp... I can't really find where the link component does the page prefetch cuz I would think the part of the flow that is breaking would be close-ish to that logic. Or it would already be failing of the local url check which would sound kinda unlikely to me because this check seems to happen before the page prefetch.
